title: Evidence Cycle 001 Wave 60C Editorial Desk
record_scope: Six Wave 60C Evidence Cycle gates and two separate named-file companion rechecks, each with an exact artifact, admissibility test, hold rule, and propagation assignment.
publication_boundary: This desk is a future-safe editorial plan. It creates no receipt, source-check result, decision, signal promotion, project-stage change, matrix-cell advance, score, ranking, or operating-outcome claim before the real dated review.

decision_contract.independence_rule: Every gate receives its own source review, receipt identity, evidence-stage decision, and propagation proof even when several checks share a date or topic.
decision_contract.future_field_rule: Decision dates, receipt IDs, attempted surfaces, access results, and propagation results remain absent from this desk and empty in the operating envelopes until the real check date.
decision_contract.named_file_rule: A companion recheck may change only its same-entity Phase 61 file and only when a qualifying official artifact changes the file's current evidence stage.
decision_contract.publication_rule: A gate publishes only after the source check, bounded receipt, source and signal decision, assigned reader-surface propagation, validation, and Git-backed release review are complete.

records.exact_next_artifact: Observed subscription or installation evidence for a fixed eligible-location cohort after service becomes available.
records.qualifying_evidence: An official location-cohort record with actual installations or subscriptions, a dated observation period, a stable eligible-location denominator, and a disclosed method.
records.insufficient_evidence: The grant agreement, planned 10,635-location coverage, service-availability language, provider-wide subscriber totals, forecasts, or an undated anecdote.
records.potential_publication_effect: May advance only the existing Louisiana Starlink adoption signal to the exact observed cohort stage supported by the returned artifact.
required_propagation: Policy And Standards To Implementation pathway

records.target: Toronto application 24 254930 enactment, condition, and permit recheck
records.exact_next_artifact: Introduced or enacted amendment numbers, accepted condition-compliance records, or the first confirmed permit, start, completion, or occupancy record for application 24 254930.
records.qualifying_evidence: An official City record tied to application 24 254930 that identifies enacted instruments, accepted conditions, or a dated project-specific delivery milestone.
records.insufficient_evidence: Council adoption alone, draft amendments, aggregate Toronto pipeline totals, an unrelated permit, marketing, financing intent, or a project milestone without the application identity.
records.potential_publication_effect: May append one same-file conversion event and update the Toronto named file only to the exact enacted, condition-cleared, permit, construction, completion, or occupancy stage established.

records.exact_next_artifact: A final FRA-accepted closeout record tied to the PIDS program scope and completed deployment denominator.
records.qualifying_evidence: A final accepted closeout identifying the PIDS program, completed deployment denominator, review authority, acceptance date, exceptions, and remaining obligations.
records.insufficient_evidence: The 93-of-93 deployment count, the completed period of performance, pending final review, a target closeout date, station construction totals, or passenger-service claims.
records.potential_publication_effect: May advance the PIDS signal only to accepted program closeout; it cannot establish display uptime, trip usability, accessibility outcomes, or named-asset reliability.

records.exact_next_artifact: A compatible material balance covering feed, immobilized glass, secondary waste, inventory change, losses, period, and reconciliation method.
records.qualifying_evidence: An official same-period balance with feed, product, secondary waste, inventory change, losses or adjustments, reconciliation method, acceptance or quality state, and compatible units.
records.insufficient_evidence: Feed volume alone, cumulative effluent alone, glass-container counts without quality and reconciliation, qualitative operating progress, milestone status, or values from incompatible periods.
records.potential_publication_effect: May advance the existing Hanford signal only to the complete material-balance scope actually reconciled; it cannot establish throughput efficiency, compliance, cost, or causation without separate evidence.

records.exact_next_artifact: A final enterprise-wide integrated cost and schedule baseline plus GAO closure evidence tied to recommendation GAO-23-104661.
records.qualifying_evidence: A program-wide life-cycle cost estimate and integrated schedule aligned with GAO best practices, plus an explicit GAO recommendation-status decision establishing closure or implementation.
records.insufficient_evidence: Agency concurrence, a forecast completion date, a project-only baseline, partial design progress, a first production unit, budget authority, or a source that does not include GAO's closure decision.
records.potential_publication_effect: May advance the existing NNSA baseline signal only to the exact enterprise-baseline and independent-closure stage established; it cannot establish accepted capacity, recurring output, or cost performance.
